ivy: Quick postmortem follow-up: the same tight-headroom + autoscale thrash popped up again during the spike. Need owners, minimal scopes, and short deadlines so we don't repeat.

hassan: I'll pick up scheduler tuning. Short scope: add a 6s preempt debounce, bump min_idle_slots to 2, and prevent immediate reclaim for 30m after large allocations.

taylor: I'll own alerts + runbook. Proposal: warning at 76% committed GPUs (slack warning), critical at 92% -> page oncall + infra lead. Runbook steps: enable reserve pool, pause noncritical batch jobs, contact infra.

ops-bot: Created issues: GPU-19901 (reserve-pool+opt-out), GPU-19902 (scheduler-debounce), GPU-19903 (alerts+runbook), GPU-19904 (surge-ci-job).

clare: I'll take the reserve-pool task. Minimal rollout: 7% reserved for premium/system with per-tenant opt-out and rollback flag. Canary one region first. Target 2026-04-10.

hassan: Scheduler PR will include perf dashboards + a 4h staging then 6h prod canary. Health gates: preemption rate <= baseline*1.25, tail P95 <= +10%. If gates fail auto-disable. Target 2026-03-30.

taylor: CI surge job: 20m mixed-seq spike, KV warmup, run nightly 2 weeks post-merge. Failures block merge and post PR comments. I'll draft the runbook by 2026-03-25.

finance-bot: Temporary reserve approved up to 6 weeks if cost delta <12% and rollback plan exists.

ivy: Recap owners & deadlines:
- GPU-19902 hassan (scheduler debounce) -> 2026-03-30
- GPU-19903 taylor (alerts + runbook) -> 2026-03-25
- GPU-19901 clare (reserve pool + opt-out) -> 2026-04-10
- GPU-19904 clare (surge CI job) -> 2026-03-28

ivy: Also scheduling a weekly 15-min incident-pattern sync for 4 weeks. ops-bot please create invite.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-24T14:00Z.
